text:
amy_s: Quick sync — FinSys wants a tight POC next week. Main asks: BYOK/KMS vs HSM requirement, rotation policy, and an HSM pricing delta. Can we confirm what we need from them and rough quote?

jordan_sales: do they insist on FIPS 140-2/3 HSM or would cloud KMS with customer-managed keys (CMEK) be acceptable? pricing will differ.

michael_sec: short answer: we support CMEK for hosted flows (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) using envelope encryption. HSM-backed keys are available for Private deployments or Dedicated with HSM add-on. If they need FIPS level hardware protection and attestation we should plan HSM.

michael_sec: security notes: we require key access via a service principal with kms:Decrypt/encrypt for the envelope key. We keep only wrapped model artifact keys; plaintext never stored. Audit logs should be provided by customer for cross-checking. Rotation frequency is a customer control — recommend 90 days for high-security customers, 12 months is common otherwise.

devon_se: For the POC we need these from FinSys: 1) KMS key ARN (or HSM token details), 2) service account email + IAM role trust, 3) short list of endpoints they plan to hit (latency/throughput) so we size Dedicated pool if needed.

devon_se: quick config example (hosted/CMEK):
```bash
export REDWOOD_CMEK_KEY_ARN=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
# assign role: redwood-inference-sa -> kms:Decrypt
```

jordan_sales: pricing ask from FinSys: "What's the monthly premium for HSM-backed keys during POC vs CMEK?" Any ballpark we can give them now?

amy_s: want a single-line answer to the customer and a follow up detailed breakdown. can we get a ballpark now and a line-item later?

michael_sec: ballpark: CMEK: no explicit key-premium for hosted (normal usage charges apply). HSM add-on: typically +$Xk/mo for reserved HSM capacity for dedicated/private POC (depends on size). For accurate quote we need expected token throughput (EPS) and retention window. I'll flag pricing team.

ops-eng: logistics: provisioning an HSM-backed Private POC takes ~10 business days for hardware and key exchange (less if using cloud HSM). Dedicated + HSM add-on can be faster but still ~5 business days for capacity and network setup.

jordan_sales: noted. FinSys is sensitive to timelines — they'll accept cloud-HSM if attestation meets their compliance.

michael_sec: two compliance caveats: 1) if they require keys to never leave their KMS, we need to verify envelope flow is acceptable (we only hold ciphertext). 2) cross-account decrypt needs explicit key policy and audit. We should ask FinSys: do you want us to have cross-account IAM, or will you create a keygrantee account we run under?

amy_s: ok. Draft reply to send to FinSys: developer-friendly short summary + asks. Can someone paste a concise blurb I can send?

devon_se: paste for customer: "We can run the POC using your cloud KMS (CMEK) or an HSM-backed key depending on your compliance needs. For CMEK we only store wrapped keys; plaintext keys are never persisted. HSM/FIPS options are supported for Private/Dedicated workflows and provide attested hardware protection. For a firm quote and timeline we need: KMS key ARN (or HSM contact), expected requests/sec and retention, and confirmation of cross-account key access. Typical lead times: CMEK (cloud) POC: 2-3 days; Dedicated+HSM: 1-2 weeks. Pricing delta: CMEK — no direct key premium; HSM — add-on (varies by size)."

amy_s: perfect. I'll send that and ask for the security questionnaire back.

deploy-bot: Reminder: create POC project POC-1723 and attach customer questionnaire to the project (automated).

jordan_sales: thanks — I'll push the email now and cc you all. :thumbsup:

ops-eng: once they confirm HSM, please open infra ticket with VPC peer info and target ASN.

amy_s: will do. closing loop when they reply.
